text:
sam: Heads-up — we should stop inferring client-facing categories from HTTP alone. Its killing the console UX and SDK behavior.
anya: Totally. We get a lot of noise: 429s for quota vs short-lived throttles, and 503s that mean different things. Console badges end up misleading customers.
sam: Proposal: keep HTTP statuses but add a single stable field `error_kind` (enum) and a short `user_message`. SDKs and console use `error_kind` for logic + telemetry.
jeff: What values do you have in mind? Keep it intentionally small.
sam: Start with: QUOTA_EXCEEDED, THROTTLE_TRANSIENT, ROUTE_DEGRADED, MODEL_NOT_LOADED, BAD_REQUEST.
maria: Product wants three badge buckets: Rate/Quota, Retryable/Transient, Needs action (client or config). Map the enum to those buckets.
priya: Draft mapping: 
QUOTA_EXCEEDED -> badge: rate/quota, telemetry: error.kind=quota
THROTTLE_TRANSIENT -> badge: transient/retry, telemetry: error.kind=throttle
ROUTE_DEGRADED -> badge: transient/retry, telemetry: error.kind=routing
MODEL_NOT_LOADED -> badge: terminal, telemetry: error.kind=model
BAD_REQUEST -> badge: terminal, telemetry: error.kind=client

sam: Also recommend we add `fallback_used` (bool) and `fallback_variant` so console can explain degraded quality vs hard failure.
jeff: Implementation note: prefer `error_kind` name to avoid mixing with internal error codes. Keep `internal_details` only in logs; do not surface to users.
anya: SDK contract: if error_kind is THROTTLE_TRANSIENT or ROUTE_DEGRADED, SDK should present retry guidance and honor `retry_after` if present; otherwise use jittered backoff. Do not auto-retry on terminal errors.
priya: Telemetry: tag with `error.kind` and `route_reason` (when routing involved). Sample high-volume tenants to prevent SLO noise.
maria: Rollout plan: flag `error-taxonomy-v1` gated by account. Console needs a beta banner that explains new badges, and a toggle to view the raw envelope for 30 days during rollout. PM wants gradual canary.
deploy-bot: deploy-notify: feature-flag `error-taxonomy-v1` created by @sam. Canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% planned.
sam: Spec snippet suggestion (server response):
{
  "status": "error",
  "http": 429,
  "error_kind": "QUOTA_EXCEEDED",
  "message": "Quota exceeded for embeddings; visit console to request more capacity.",
  "retry_after": 3600,
  "fallback_used": false,
  "internal_details": "quotaBucket=user:12345:embeddings"
}
anya: Keep `message` short and localized-ready. `internal_details` only goes to logs and traces.
jeff: I'll open the schema PR and add a validator to the CI that checks responses against the enum during rollout.
priya: I'll sketch telemetry sampling and dashboard migration to `error.kind`.
maria: I'll own console badge mapping + banner copy.
sam: Action list: 1) schema PR to add `error_kind`, `fallback_used`, `fallback_variant` 2) Console mapping + beta banner + toggle 3) SDK updates to honor `error_kind` 4) Telemetry sampling + dashboards. Sync next week after canary starts. :thumbsup:
